predicate.label: killed by perpetrator
predicate.definition: Person X or explicitly affected members of population X were killed by perpetrator Y or explicitly identified agents of Y.
includes: explicit killed-by or murder-by with correct victim and perpetrator roles
explicit killing by the named authority soldiers or troops
historical killing of identified members of a population
excludes: shooting or injury without established death
a population assertion interpreted as death of every member
ambiguous: unresolved identity of troops or agents
shooting where fatal outcome is unspecified
predicate.notes: This direction is victim to perpetrator. The evaluation concerns textual support only; it does not independently adjudicate historical responsibility.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit killed-by or murder-by with correct victim and perpetrator roles; explicit killing by the named authority soldiers or troops; historical killing of identified members of a population. Excludes: geographic death-place; occupation or hostility alone; shooting or injury without established death; a population assertion interpreted as death of every member. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear victim or perpetrator attachment; unresolved identity of troops or agents; shooting where fatal outcome is unspecified. This direction is victim to perpetrator. The evaluation concerns textual support only; it does not independently adjudicate historical responsibility.

rationale: Victim killed-by and named troops/soldiers family dominates inverse death-causing agency, distinguished from occupation or shooting without death.
